slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not proactively ask about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck. Its broad question about 'additional constraints' in turn 4 did not target truck capacity, and its turn 5 question about the cost impact of the truck limit came only after the user simulator volunteered the 2-container limit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The truck capacity limit is 2 containers per trip and does not affect the cost calculation or the model formulation.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never independently asked about truck capacity; the limit was volunteered by the user simulator in turn 4, and the agent accepted it as true in its READY_TO_MODEL summary without confirming the fact through its own question.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1) is P2. No unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so stopping was appropriate despite the unasked P2 detail.

summary: The agent clarified the core cost function, integrality, and supply/demand balance, but never proactively asked about truck capacity; it treated the user-volunteered 2-container limit as true in its final summary. Stopping was appropriate because the only hidden slot was P2.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
